stable_cross_donor_findings: AgentSight is useful primarily as a read-only independent observability witness for process/file/network/resource/tool activity.
Full live eBPF/TLS capture is Linux- and privilege-sensitive; fallback/native-session evidence must retain its weaker provenance class.
Correlation includes process lineage plus temporal/argument heuristics and therefore cannot be treated as exact F2 causal identity under concurrency.
Captured prompts/responses/headers/paths/network targets create a sensitive-data surface requiring explicit minimization/redaction/retention policy.
AgentSight storage, inferred sessions, or secondary-LLM analysis must never become UnifiedDB truth, EffectGate/EffectJournal authority, or completion authority.
Preferred adoption direction is concept distillation plus bounded sidecar/offline witness evaluation, not direct architecture import.
